title: "Gram embed demo"

This page demonstrates the [gram Quarto extension](_extensions/gram/README.md):
Gram recipes rendered statically at build time.

## From a recipe file

{{< gram src="../recipes/canneles.gram" >}}

## Inline Gram source

```{.gram}
## Tomato Soup
[Sauté] @onion{1}, chopped, in @olive oil{2tbsp} for ~{5 min}.
[Simmer] with @tomato{800g} and @stock{500ml} for ~{20 min}.
[Blend] until smooth.
```

## Scaled 2×

```{.gram scale=2}
## Pancakes
[Fry] @flour{200g} in @butter{30g}, ~{3 min} per side.
```
